title: symphyotrichum × gravesii
intro: Symphyotrichum × gravesii, commonly known as the hybrid New England aster, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Symphyotrichum × gravesii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory infections. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and antispasmodic effects.
